info.title: AeroDB API
info.summary: The AeroDB API provides access to a wide range of aeronautical data.
info.description:
## General Information

- All properties are **always returned** and **must be provided**,
but can be `null` if not applicable.
- Some endpoints require **authentication via API key**.

## Filtering, Sorting & Offset

Certain endpoints support **filtering**, **sorting**, and **offset** to control and refine list results.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|------------|-------|----------|--------------|
| `limit` | `int32` | `100` | Maximum number of items per page. Cannot exceed **300**. |
| `offset` | `int32` | `0` | Number of items to skip before starting to collect results. |
| `filter` | `string` (Base64) | — | Base64-encoded JSON object defining filtering conditions. |
| `sort` | `string` (Base64) | — | Base64-encoded JSON object defining sorting order. |

---

### Filtering Example

You can filter airports by one or more properties using a **Base64-encoded JSON filter**.

#### JSON before encoding:
```json
{
  "AND": [
    {
      "countryCode": {
        "in": ["ES"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Base64 encoded:
```
eyJBTkQiOlt7ImNvdW50cnlDb2RlIjp7ImluIjpbIkVTIl19fV19
```

#### Final request:
> /airports?limit=50&offset=0&filter=eyJBTkQiOlt7ImNvdW50cnlDb2RlIjp7ImluIjpbIkVTIl19fV19

---

### Sorting Example

You can define multiple sort rules, each specifying a property and direction (`asc` or `desc`).

#### JSON before encoding:
```json
{
  "sort": [
    { "name": "asc" },
    { "city": "desc" }
  ]
}
```

#### Base64 encoded:
```
eyJzb3J0IjpbeyJuYW1lIjoiYXNjIn0seyJjaXR5IjoiZGVzYyJ9XX0=
```

#### Final request:
> /airports?limit=20&sort=eyJzb3J0IjpbeyJuYW1lIjoiYXNjIn0seyJjaXR5IjoiZGVzYyJ9XX0=

---

### Combined Example

You can combine **filter**, **sort**, **limit**, and **offset** in a single request.

#### Decoded filter value:
```json
{
  "AND": [
    {
      "countryCode": {
        "in": ["ES"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Decoded sort value:
```json
{
  "sort": [
    { "name": "asc" },
    { "city": "desc" }
  ]
}
```

#### Final request:
> /airports?limit=100&offset=200&filter=eyJBTkQiOlt7ImNvdW50cnlDb2RlIjp7ImluIjpbIkVTIl19fV19&sort=eyJzb3J0IjpbeyJuYW1lIjoiYXNjIn0seyJjaXR5IjoiZGVzYyJ9XX0=

This will return up to **100 Spanish airports**, skipping the first **200**, sorted by **name (asc)** then **city (desc)**.

---

## Rate Limiting

- The API enforces a per-IP rate limit of approximately **10 requests per second**.
- Exceeding this limit returns a `429 Too Many Requests` response.

Use these headers to monitor your current rate limit status:

- `X-Ratelimit-Limit`
- `X-Ratelimit-Remaining`
- `X-Ratelimit-Reset-Ms`

---

Return a user account based on a valid OAuth token from a provider based on the user's email.

If the user does not exist, a new account is created with a generated password.

The provider will be linked to the user account for future logins.

Return 401 if the OAuth token is invalid or expired.

name.description: Short name or identifier for the airspace (1-32 characters)

type.description:
Airspace type classification
- R: Restricted Area
- D: Danger Area
- P: Prohibited Area
- CTR: Control Zone
- TMZ: Transponder Mandatory Zone
- RMZ: Radio Mandatory Zone
- TMA: Terminal Control Area
- TRA: Temporary Reserved Area
- TSA: Temporary Segregated Area
- FIR: Flight Information Region
- UIR: Upper Flight Information Region
- ADIZ: Air Defense Identification Zone
- ATZ: Aerodrome Traffic Zone
- MATZ: Military Aerodrome Traffic Zone
- AWY: Airway
- MTR: Military Training Route
- ALR: Alert Area
- WRA: Warning Area
- PA: Protected Area
- HTZ: Helicopter Traffic Zone
- GLD: Gliding Sector
- TRP: Terminal Reporting Point Area
- TIZ: Traffic Information Zone
- TIA: Traffic Information Area
- MTA: Military Training Area
- CTA: Control Area
- ACC: Area Control Centre Sector
- ASR: Aerial Sporting or Recreational Activity Area
- LAOR: Low Altitude Overflight Restriction Area
- MRT: Military Route
- TFR: Temporary Flight Restriction
- VFRS: VFR Sector
- FISS: Flight Information Service Sector
- LTA: Low Traffic Area / Low Altitude TMA (country dependent usage)
- UTA: Upper Control Area
- MCTR: Military Control Zone

class.description:
ICAO airspace classification from A (most restrictive) to G (least restrictive)

- **A**: IFR only, full ATC separation, no VFR allowed
- **B**: IFR/VFR allowed, full ATC separation for all aircraft
- **C**: IFR/VFR allowed, IFR fully separated, VFR separated from IFR only
- **D**: IFR/VFR allowed, IFR separated from IFR, VFR receives traffic advisories
- **E**: IFR/VFR allowed, IFR receives full service, VFR operates independently
- **F**: Advisory service only, rarely used (being phased out)
- **G**: Uncontrolled airspace, no ATC separation provided

activity.description:
Primary activity conducted within the airspace
- PAR: Parachuting Activity
- ACR: Aerobatics Activity
- AWK: Aeroclub And Aerial Work Area
- ULM: Ultra Light Machine Activity
- HGP: Hang Gliding/Paragliding

activatedByNotam.description: Indicates if the airspace is activated by NOTAM (Notice to Airmen)

requiresSpecialAgreement.description: Indicates if the airspace requires special agreement for activation

requiresRequestCompliance.description: Indicates if compliance with requests is mandatory for this airspace

geometry.description: GeoJSON representation of the airspace geometry

upperLimit.description: Upper limit of the airspace in feet or flight level

upperLimitIsFlightLevel.description: Indicates if the upper limit is specified as a flight level

lowerLimit.description: Lower limit of the airspace in feet or flight level

lowerLimitIsFlightLevel.description: Indicates if the lower limit is specified as a flight level

ReadAirspace.description:
Represents an airspace with its properties, classification, and operational characteristics.
An airspace is a defined three-dimensional region of airspace within which specific rules,
restrictions, or procedures may apply to aircraft operations.

category.description:
Singular lowercase category of the changed item.

Examples: `airport`, `airspace`, `notam`.

itemId.description: Canonical database id of the changed item.

date.description: Date when the change was recorded.

changes.description:
JSON payload containing an RFC 6902 JSON Patch document.

Example:
```json
[
  { "op": "replace", "path": "/name", "value": "Updated Geneva" }
]
```

ReadChange.description:
Represents a stored item change.

Contains a JSON Patch document
as defined by RFC 6902.

isLighted.description: True if the helipad is lighted, false if not, null if unknown.

longitude.description: Longitude of the helipad in decimal degrees, null if unknown.

elevation.description: Elevation of the helipad in feet, null if unknown.

geometry.description: A GeoJSON geometry representing the helipad location and shape.

isSnowtam.description:
Indicates if the NOTAM is a SNOWTAM.
A SNOWTAM (Snow and/or Ice NOTAM) is a special type of NOTAM (Notice to Airmen) issued by an airport to provide pilots with critical information about hazardous conditions on the movement area (runways and taxiways) caused by snow, ice, slush, frost, or standing water

isProcedure.description: Indicates if the NOTAM is related to a procedure.
